name_zh: 江铃汽车股份有限公司

key_facts.value_en: 1992 (restructured as a joint-stock company on 1992-06-16; predecessor dates to 1947)
key_facts.value_zh: 1992 年（1992-06-16 改组设立股份公司；前身可追溯至 1947 年）
中国江西省南昌市南昌县迎宾中大道 2111 号
国有控股的中外合资上市公司

key_facts.value_en: Jiangling Motors Group Co., Ltd. and Chongqing Changan Automobile Co., Ltd. (named in the annual report)
key_facts.value_zh: 江铃汽车集团有限公司、重庆长安汽车股份有限公司（年报认定）

key_facts.label_en: Net profit attributable to owners of the parent (FY2025)

history.event_en: Nanchang Automobile Maintenance Plant, the predecessor of Jiangling Motors Group, is established.
history.event_zh: 江铃集团前身南昌汽车保养厂成立。

history.event_en: Jiangxi Automobile Manufacturing Plant produces its first 12 'Jinggangshan' 2.5-tonne trucks, beginning vehicle manufacturing.
history.event_zh: 江西汽车制造厂生产出第一批 12 辆“井冈山”牌 2.5 吨载重汽车，开始整车制造。

history.event_en: With Isuzu technology, the first Jiangling N-series light truck rolls off the line.
history.event_zh: 引进日本五十铃技术，第一辆江铃 N 系列轻卡下线。

history.event_en: The company is restructured into a Sino-foreign joint-stock company on the basis of Jiangxi Automobile Manufacturing Plant (per the financial reports).
history.event_zh: 在江西汽车制造厂基础上改组设立中外合资股份制企业（财务报告记载口径）。

history.event_en: Jiangling Motors Corporation, Ltd. is founded as a joint-stock company (per the group's official history; a different registration basis from the 1992-06-16 date above).
history.event_zh: 江铃汽车股份有限公司创立（集团官网记载口径，与财务报告的 1992-06-16 口径不同）。

history.event_en: JMC's A-shares list on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange (000550), the first listed company in Jiangxi Province.
history.event_zh: A 股在深圳证券交易所挂牌上市（000550），为江西省首家上市公司。

history.event_en: JMC signs a long-term cooperation agreement with Ford; Ford pays US$40 million for JMC B-shares, taking a 20% stake.
history.event_zh: 与美国福特汽车公司签署长期合作协议，福特出资 4000 万美元购入 B 股、占 20% 股权。

history.event_en: The JMC Transit (Quanshun) plant is completed and the first locally built Ford Transit rolls off the line.
history.event_zh: 江铃全顺汽车厂建成投产，第一辆国产全顺（Ford Transit）下线。

history.event_en: After an additional B-share issue on 12 November 1998, Ford's stake in JMC rises to 29.96% (per the annual report's record of changes in controlling shareholders; the group's official history dates this event differently).
history.event_zh: 1998 年 11 月 12 日增发 B 股后，福特持股比例提高至 29.96%（按年报“历次控股股东的变更情况”记载口径；集团官网对此事件日期记载略有不同）。

history.event_en: Jiangling Holdings Co., Ltd. is established by JMC Group and Changan Automobile.
history.event_zh: 江铃集团与长安汽车成立江铃控股有限公司。

history.event_en: JMC Group transfers 354,176,000 JMC shares (41.03% of the company) to Jiangling Holdings; this is the completed share transfer, distinct from the earlier capital-increase arrangements. Earlier that year, on 5 August 2005, Ford's holding reached 258,964,200 shares (30%) after purchases totalling 321,400 B-shares on 2, 3 and 5 August. The acquisition report was published on 22 September 2005.
history.event_zh: 江铃集团将所持江铃汽车 354,176,000 股（占总股本 41.03%）过户至江铃控股；此为股份转让完成日期，区别于此前的增资安排。同年较早的 8 月 5 日，福特在 8 月 2、3、5 日累计购入 321,400 股 B 股后，持股达到 258,964,200 股（30%）；收购报告书全文于 9 月 22 日披露。

history.event_en: JMC's first self-developed SUV, the Yusheng, rolls off the line.
history.event_zh: 江铃首款自主 SUV“驭胜”下线。

history.event_en: Jiangling Heavy Duty Truck Co., Ltd., based in Taiyuan, Shanxi, is unveiled.
history.event_zh: 位于山西太原的江铃重型汽车有限公司揭牌成立。

history.event_en: Ford completes its share-purchase plan, raising its stake in JMC to 32%.
history.event_zh: 福特完成股份收购计划，持有江铃股份 32% 股份。

history.event_en: The new Jiangling Holdings completes restructuring: Aiways, JMC Group and Changan hold 50%, 25% and 25% respectively (involving the Landwind brand and vehicle-production qualification).
history.event_zh: 新江铃控股完成重组，爱驰汽车、江铃集团、长安汽车分别持股 50%、25%、25%（涉及陆风品牌与生产资质）。

history.event_en: The Fushan plant holds its full-production ceremony; it covers about 1,500 mu (100 hectares), involved total investment of about RMB12.8 billion and has annual capacity of 300,000 vehicles.
history.event_zh: 富山工厂举行全面投产活动，占地 1500 亩、总投资约 128 亿元、具备 30 万辆整车生产能力。

history.event_en: JMC Ford Automotive Technology (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. is established (JMC 51%, Ford 49%, registered capital RMB200 million) to run Ford-brand passenger vehicles and pickups in China.
history.event_zh: 江铃福特汽车科技（上海）有限公司成立（江铃持股 51%、福特 49%，注册资本 2 亿元），运营福特品牌乘用车与皮卡。

history.event_en: The locally built Ford Ranger (Youqixia) pickup goes on sale from RMB145,800.
history.event_zh: 国产福特游骑侠 Ranger 皮卡上市（14.58 万元起）。

history.event_en: The Ford Bronco (Liema) off-road SUV launches in China from RMB299,800.
history.event_zh: 福特烈马（Bronco）越野 SUV 上市，售价 29.98 万元起。

history.event_en: JMC resolves to entrust distribution of Ford-brand passenger vehicles and pickups to Ford Motor Sales & Service (Shanghai) Co., Ltd., a wholly-owned Ford China subsidiary, and to jointly inject capital with Ford into JMC Ford Automotive Technology (Shanghai) to repay its debts; the joint venture is to be wound up and deregistered after the debts are settled.
history.event_zh: 江铃汽车决议将福特品牌乘用车与皮卡分销委托给福特全资的福特汽车销售服务（上海）有限公司，并与福特共同增资用于清偿江铃福特汽车科技（上海）负债；该合资公司拟在债务清偿完成后清算注销。

brands.role_en: Core light-commercial-vehicle brand covering light trucks, pickups and light buses.
brands.role_zh: 核心商用车品牌，覆盖轻卡、皮卡、轻客。
brands.owner_note_en: Flagship brand of the listed JMC. Key models include the Shunda light truck, the Baodian, Domain Tiger (Yuhu) and Dadao pickups, and the Teshun light bus. In 2025 the company's products (JMC and Ford combined) ranked first in the light-bus segment, second in pickups and seventh in light trucks; these are company-level rankings, not JMC single-brand rankings.
brands.owner_note_zh: 上市公司江铃汽车旗舰品牌。主力车型含顺达轻卡，宝典、域虎、大道皮卡与特顺轻客。2025 年江铃汽车公司产品（含福特品牌）轻客市占份额居行业第一、皮卡第二、轻卡第七；此为江铃汽车公司层面的细分市场排名，并非 JMC 单一品牌排名。

brands.role_en: Ford-brand light buses, MPVs, SUVs and pickups produced and sold through the JMC-Ford partnership.
brands.role_zh: 依托江铃与福特合作，生产销售福特品牌轻客、MPV、SUV 与皮卡。
brands.owner_note_en: Ford has been a JMC shareholder since 1995. Key models include the Transit (Quanshun) light bus, the Tourneo MPV, the Equator and Equator Sport SUVs, the Ranger pickup and the Bronco off-road SUV, and the Zhiqu Liema new-energy SUV launched in Nanchang in December 2025. The Bronco launched on 25 April 2024 from RMB299,800 and the locally built Ranger in December 2023 from RMB145,800.
brands.owner_note_zh: 福特 1995 年起入股江铃。主力车型含全顺（Transit）轻客、途睿欧 MPV、领睿、领裕 SUV、游骑侠 Ranger 皮卡与烈马 Bronco 越野 SUV，以及 2025 年 12 月在南昌上市的智趣烈马新能源 SUV。烈马于 2024 年 4 月 25 日上市（29.98 万元起），国产游骑侠于 2023 年 12 月上市（14.58 万元起）。

brands.name_en: JMC Ford Automotive Technology (Shanghai) Co., Ltd.
brands.name_zh: 江铃福特汽车科技（上海）有限公司
brands.role_en: Joint venture that ran Ford-brand passenger-vehicle research, development and sales.
brands.role_zh: 运营福特品牌乘用车研发与销售的合资公司。
brands.price_band: Not applicable (sales and R&D joint venture, no direct manufacturing)
brands.owner_note_en: Established 2021-12-07 with registered capital of RMB200 million, 51% owned by JMC and 49% by Ford. It sold 29,793 vehicles in 2025, and its Ranger and Bronco models each ranked first in their domestic segments that year. It accumulated losses of about RMB2.37 billion over 2022-2025 (2025 net loss RMB751 million). In September 2025 JMC resolved to entrust distribution of Ford-brand passenger vehicles and pickups to Ford Motor Sales & Service (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. and to inject capital with Ford (JMC RMB1.264 billion by debt-to-equity, Ford RMB1.214 billion in cash) to repay the venture's debts; per the 2025-042 announcement, from 1 October 2025 the venture carries out debt-settlement activities and will be liquidated and deregistered after settlement. The 2026 interim report still lists it as a 51%-owned consolidated subsidiary.
brands.owner_note_zh: 2021-12-07 成立，注册资本 2 亿元，江铃持股 51%、福特持股 49%。2025 年销量 29,793 台，其中烈马及游骑侠在各自细分市场年累份额均排名第一。2022—2025 年累计亏损约 23.73 亿元（2025 年净亏损 7.51 亿元）。2025 年 9 月，江铃汽车决议将福特品牌乘用车与皮卡分销委托给福特汽车销售服务（上海）有限公司，并与福特共同增资（江铃债转股出资 12.6378 亿元、福特现金出资 12.1422 亿元）用于清偿该公司负债；按 2025-042 号公告，自 2025 年 10 月 1 日起该公司开展与债务清偿相关的业务活动，完成清偿后将清算注销。2026 年半年报仍将其列为持股 51% 的合并子公司。

brands.role_zh: 江铃自主 SUV 品牌。
brands.owner_note_en: First model (Yusheng S350) rolled off the line in October 2010. The 2024 and 2025 annual reports no longer list Yusheng in the main-business product description (only JMC-brand and Ford-brand products), and no separate production or sales data is disclosed. No announcement formally confirms discontinuation, so the brand's status is marked as uncertain.
brands.owner_note_zh: 首款车型（驭胜 S350）2010 年 10 月下线。2024—2025 年年报主营业务描述已不再列示驭胜（仅列 JMC 品牌与福特品牌产品），亦无单独产销数据披露。公司未就品牌是否正式停用发布公告，故状态标注为未确认。

brands.role_en: Heavy-duty truck subsidiary based in Taiyuan, Shanxi.
brands.role_zh: 位于山西太原的重型卡车子公司。
brands.owner_note_en: Unveiled in February 2013. In 2025 the subsidiary generated revenue of RMB2.0986 million and a net loss of RMB29.2449 million. At its results briefing on 16 April 2026, JMC confirmed that this subsidiary had stopped operating.
brands.owner_note_zh: 2013 年 2 月揭牌。2025 年该子公司营收 209.86 万元、净亏损 2,924.49 万元。公司于 2026 年 4 月 16 日业绩说明会确认江铃重汽已停止经营。

financials.note_en: Fiscal year ends 31 December. Figures are prepared under PRC GAAP (Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises), in RMB millions, rounded to the nearest million; 'gross_margin_pct' is rounded to one decimal place. 'net_profit' is profit attributable to owners of the parent (归母净利润), not total net profit including minority interests; in 2025 profit attributable to the parent exceeded total net profit mainly because the loss-making subsidiary JMC Ford Automotive Technology (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. (51%-owned by JMC) reduced minority interests. 'rnd' is total R&D investment including capitalised amounts: RMB1,846 million, RMB1,700 million and RMB1,490 million for 2023-2025, of which expensed R&D in 2025 was RMB1,216 million. The 2023 gross margin of 14.4% is on the restated basis after the retrospective reclassification of warranty costs into cost of sales. 'ocf' is net cash flow from operating activities. FY2023 and FY2024 are from the three-year principal accounting data in the 2024 annual report; FY2025 is from the 2025 annual report.
financials.note_zh: 财年截至 12 月 31 日。数据按中国企业会计准则（PRC GAAP）编制，单位人民币百万元，金额四舍五入至百万，'gross_margin_pct' 保留一位小数。'net_profit' 为归属于母公司股东的净利润（归母净利润）口径，而非含少数股东损益的净利润总额；2025 年归母净利润高于净利润总额，主要因亏损子公司江铃福特汽车科技（上海）有限公司（江铃持股 51%）冲减少数股东权益所致。'rnd' 为研发投入（含资本化）：2023—2025 年分别为 18.46 亿元、17.00 亿元、14.90 亿元，其中 2025 年费用化研发费用为 12.16 亿元。2023 年毛利率 14.4% 为按质保费用转入营业成本的追溯调整后的重述口径。'ocf' 为经营活动产生的现金流量净额。2023、2024 财年取自 2024 年年度报告“近三年主要会计数据”，2025 财年取自 2025 年年度报告。

overview.en:
Jiangling Motors Corporation, Ltd. (JMC; SZSE 000550 A-share, 200550 B-share) is a commercial-vehicle and SUV manufacturer headquartered in Nanchang, Jiangxi. It is the listed vehicle-making arm of Jiangling Motors Group (JMCG) and a long-standing partner of Ford Motor Company, which has held a stake in JMC since 1995 and now owns 32.00% [s4]. JMC makes and sells JMC-brand light trucks, pickups and light buses, and Ford-brand light buses, MPVs, SUVs and pickups; in FY2025 it reported operating revenue of RMB39.17 billion and profit attributable to owners of the parent of RMB1.19 billion, and sold 377,253 vehicles including 160,000 exports [s1][s8].

JMC is a state-controlled Sino-foreign listed company: its controlling shareholders are Nanchang Jiangling Investment Co., Ltd. (41.03%, a state-owned legal person) and Ford Motor Company (32.00%); the annual report identifies Jiangling Motors Group Co., Ltd. and Chongqing Changan Automobile Co., Ltd. as the actual controllers [s1]. Its products ranked first in China's light-bus segment, second in pickups and seventh in light trucks in 2025 [s8].
overview.zh:
江铃汽车股份有限公司（深交所 000550 A 股、200550 B 股）是总部位于江西省南昌市的商用车与 SUV 制造企业，是江铃汽车集团有限公司的上市整车主体，也是福特汽车公司的长期合作伙伴——福特自 1995 年起持股，现持股 32.00% [s4]。公司生产销售 JMC 品牌轻卡、皮卡、轻客，以及福特品牌轻客、MPV、SUV 与皮卡；2025 财年实现营业收入 391.70 亿元、归属于母公司股东的净利润 11.87 亿元，销售整车 37.73 万辆、其中出口 16 万辆 [s1][s8]。

江铃汽车为国有控股的中外合资上市公司：控股股东为南昌市江铃投资有限公司（持股 41.03%，国有法人）与福特汽车公司（持股 32.00%）；年报认定的实际控制人为江铃汽车集团有限公司、重庆长安汽车股份有限公司 [s1]。2025 年公司产品轻客市占份额居行业第一、皮卡第二、轻卡第七 [s8]。

current.en:
Business structure

JMC's main business is manufacturing and selling commercial vehicles and SUVs plus related parts. In FY2025 whole-vehicle revenue was RMB35.96 billion (91.8% of operating revenue), materials and parts RMB2.11 billion (5.39%), and maintenance and technical services RMB1.10 billion (2.81%); gross margins for the three lines were 11.88%, 30.23% and 36.99% respectively [s1][s9]. In 2025 the company produced 378,338 and sold 377,253 vehicles, comprising 99,770 light buses, 83,207 trucks, 59,681 pickups and 134,595 SUVs [s1]. Beyond complete vehicles, the annual report's description of the company's basic situation covers production and sales of vehicles and parts, after-sales service, import and export, used vehicles, management consulting and freight-capacity services [s1].

Products and models

JMC's JMC-brand lineup includes the Shunda light truck, the Baodian, Domain Tiger (Yuhu) and Dadao pickups, and the Teshun light bus; Ford-brand products include the Transit (Quanshun) light bus, the Tourneo MPV, the Equator and Equator Sport SUVs, the Ranger pickup and the Bronco off-road SUV. The 2025 annual report also records the launch of the Ford Zhiqu Liema new-energy SUV in Nanchang in December 2025 [s1]. The locally built Ranger launched in December 2023 from RMB145,800, and the Bronco launched on 25 April 2024 from RMB299,800 [s14][s4].

New energy

In 2025 JMC produced 37,304 and sold 35,806 NEVs, with NEV revenue of RMB2.958 billion; of this, NEV commercial vehicles accounted for production of 32,373 and sales of 32,557 (revenue RMB2.404 billion), and NEV passenger vehicles for production of 4,931 and sales of 3,249 (revenue RMB554 million) [s1][s8]. The company has laid out a full NEV lineup across light buses, pickups and light trucks, and in January 2025 launched the E Fushun light bus and E Shunda light truck, both pure-electric commercial vehicles [s4].

Technology and platforms

In March 2025 the company released the new 'Blue Flame' powertrain platform, and in April 2025 jointly released a 'super light-truck system solution' with Bosch at the Shanghai Auto Show; the group has also self-developed the IDEA electronic/electrical architecture and a 'nine-in-one' central computing platform for commercial vehicles [s4]. FY2025 R&D investment was RMB1.490 billion, down 12.31% year on year, with capitalised R&D at 18.41% of the total [s1][s9].

Plants and capacity

JMC's main manufacturing base is the Fushan plant in the Xiaolan Economic Development Zone, Nanchang, which went into full production on 9 September 2021. It covers about 1,500 mu (100 hectares), involved total investment of about RMB12.8 billion and has annual capacity of 300,000 vehicles, producing JMC-brand light trucks (conventional and new-energy) and Ford-brand SUVs such as the Equator and Equator Sport [s18][s4][s13].

Overseas business

The listed company exported 160,000 vehicles in 2025, up 38.4% year on year [s1][s8]. At the group level, exports rose from about 34,000 vehicles in 2021 to about 169,900 in 2025, a compound annual growth rate of about 49% during the 14th Five-Year Plan period, with overseas sales concentrated in the Middle East, Africa, Latin America, Southeast Asia and the Caribbean [s15]. The group operates 102 overseas dealer channels and 13 KD (knocked-down) assembly plants; in Algeria it produces locally via KD assembly with annual exports exceeding 10,000 units, and in 2025 six markets (including Vietnam, Argentina and Saudi Arabia) each exceeded 10,000 units, with a further 16 markets above 1,000 units [s15]. In 2025 the group exported more than 34,000 vehicles to the Middle East region, where Saudi Arabia became its first 10,000-unit market [s15]. Products aimed at overseas markets include the E-luda electric light truck meeting European standards, a new-generation pickup and a pure-electric SUV [s15].

Latest results (as of 2026-10-29)

As of 29 October 2026, JMC's most recently disclosed results are for the first nine months of 2026: revenue of RMB28.786 billion (up 5.49% year on year) and profit attributable to owners of the parent of RMB907 million (up 21.02%), with operating cash flow of RMB1.782 billion; cumulative vehicle sales rose 9.32% to 285,285 units, comprising 82,132 light buses, 58,583 trucks, 45,058 pickups and 99,512 SUVs [s3][s11]. Third-quarter profit attributable to the parent rose 922.92% year on year to RMB168 million. The report attributes the increases in profit attributable to the parent and profit excluding non-recurring items for the first nine months mainly to the effect of deferred tax assets reversed following JMC Ford Automotive Technology (Shanghai)'s business adjustment in the third quarter of 2025. Income tax expense in the first nine months of 2026 fell by RMB507 million, or 77.84%, mainly because of that prior-year tax effect [s3].
current.zh:
业务结构

江铃汽车主业为生产和销售商用车、乘用车 SUV 及相关零部件。2025 财年整车收入 359.56 亿元（占营业收入 91.8%）、材料及零部件收入 21.11 亿元（5.39%）、保养及技术服务等收入 11.02 亿元（2.81%），三项毛利率分别为 11.88%、30.23%、36.99% [s1][s9]。2025 年整车产量 378,338 辆、销量 377,253 辆，分车型为轻客 99,770 辆、卡车 83,207 辆、皮卡 59,681 辆、SUV 134,595 辆 [s1]。除整车外，年报对“公司基本情况”的描述涵盖汽车及零部件生产销售、售后服务、进出口、二手车、管理咨询与运力服务 [s1]。

产品谱系

JMC 品牌阵容含顺达轻卡，宝典、域虎、大道皮卡与特顺轻客；福特品牌产品含全顺（Transit）轻客、途睿欧 MPV、领睿、领裕 SUV、游骑侠 Ranger 皮卡与烈马 Bronco 越野 SUV。2025 年年报另披露，福特智趣烈马新能源 SUV 于 2025 年 12 月在南昌正式上市 [s1]。国产游骑侠于 2023 年 12 月上市（14.58 万元起），福特烈马于 2024 年 4 月 25 日上市（29.98 万元起）[s14][s4]。

新能源

2025 年新能源整车产销 37,304 台、35,806 台，销售收入 29.58 亿元；其中新能源商用车产销 32,373 台、32,557 台、收入 24.04 亿元，新能源乘用车产销 4,931 台、3,249 台、收入 5.54 亿元 [s1][s8]。公司已布局轻客、皮卡、轻卡全谱系新能源产品，2025 年 1 月推出全新纯电商用车 E 福顺轻客与 E 顺达轻卡 [s4]。

技术与平台

2025 年 3 月公司发布全新动力品牌“蓝焰动力平台”，2025 年 4 月与博世在上海车展联合发布“超级轻卡系统解决方案”；集团还自主研发了 IDEA 电子电气架构和商用车“九合一”中央计算平台 [s4]。2025 财年研发投入 14.90 亿元，同比下降 12.31%，资本化研发投入占比 18.41% [s1][s9]。

工厂与产能

江铃汽车主要生产基地为位于南昌小蓝经开区的富山工厂，2021 年 9 月 9 日全面投产，占地 1500 亩、总投资约 128 亿元、具备年产 30 万辆整车能力，生产 JMC 品牌轻卡（传统能源与新能源）及领睿、领裕等福特品牌 SUV [s18][s4][s13]。

海外业务

上市公司 2025 年出口 16 万辆，同比增长 38.4% [s1][s8]。集团层面，出口量从 2021 年约 3.4 万台增至 2025 年约 16.99 万台，“十四五”期间复合增长率约 49%，海外销售集中于中东、非洲、拉美、东南亚及加勒比地区 [s15]。集团在海外拥有 102 家经销渠道与 13 个 KD 组装工厂；在阿尔及利亚通过 KD 散件组装实现本地化生产、年出口超万台，2025 年越南、阿根廷、沙特等 6 个国家销量突破万台，另有 16 个市场超千台 [s15]。2025 年集团对中东区域累计出口 3.4 万余台，沙特成为江铃在中东的第一个万台市场 [s15]。面向海外的产品包括符合欧洲标准的电动轻卡 E 路达、新一代皮卡与纯电 SUV [s15]。

最新业绩（截至 2026-10-29）

截至 2026 年 10 月 29 日，江铃汽车已披露的最近一期业绩为 2026 年前三季度：实现营业收入 287.86 亿元（同比增长 5.49%）、归属于母公司股东的净利润 9.07 亿元（同比增长 21.02%）、经营活动现金流净额 17.82 亿元；累计销售整车 285,285 辆（28.53 万辆），同比增长 9.32%，其中轻客 82,132 辆、卡车 58,583 辆、皮卡 45,058 辆、SUV 99,512 辆 [s3][s11]。单第三季度归母净利润 1.68 亿元，同比增长 922.92%。三季报说明，前三季度归母净利润及扣非归母净利润同比增长，主要受江铃福特汽车科技（上海）在 2025 年第三季度业务调整带来的递延所得税资产转回影响；2026 年前三季度所得税费用同比减少 5.07 亿元（下降 77.84%），主要由于上年同期该项税务影响 [s3]。

leadership.en:
Founder

JMC has no individual founder. Its predecessor is the state-run Nanchang Automobile Maintenance Plant (founded April 1947), renamed Jiangxi Automobile Manufacturing Plant in October 1967, which began vehicle production in 1968; the financial reports record that the company was restructured into a Sino-foreign joint-stock company on 16 June 1992, while the group's official history records the founding of the joint-stock company as 22 November 1993 [s1][s4].

Key management

  • Qiu Tiangao (born 1966), chairman since 2016-04-07. He is also chairman of Jiangling Motors Group (since April 2014), Nanchang Jiangling Investment, Jiangxi Isuzu Motors and Jiangling Group New Energy Vehicle. He previously served as general manager and chairman of Nanchang Gear Co., chairman of Jiangxi Jiangling Gear Co., vice president of Jiangling Holdings, and director, general manager and chairman of Jiangling Motors Group [s1][s4].
  • Xiong Chunying (born 1964), director (since 2021-06-25) and president (since 2021-05-01). A senior engineer, she previously served as head of the quality-management department, assistant to the president, vice president, executive vice president and director [s1].
  • Wu Shengbo (born 1966, US citizen), vice chairman since 2022-11-24. He is group vice president of Ford Motor Company, president and CEO of Ford's China and International Markets Group, and chairman, president and CEO of Ford Motor (China) [s1].
  • Ding Wenmin (born 1972), first executive vice president since 2026-09-29 (previously executive vice president since 2022-06-01). He is a standing committee member of the party committee of Jiangling Motors Group and secretary of the party committee of JMC. He previously served as deputy director of the product-development technology centre, head of product planning and project management, assistant to the president, vice president, and a director of Jiangling Group [s7].
  • Zhong Junhua (born 1976), director since 2024-04-11. In September 2026 she resigned as executive vice president (a post she had held since 2024-03-26) due to organisational arrangements and was reassigned as deputy party secretary, general manager and director of Jiangling Motors Group; she remains a director of the listed company [s1][s6].
  • Zeng Fafa (born 1978), executive vice president since 2026-09-29. He previously served as deputy head of the quality-management department, head of the new-model launch management department, head of quality management, head of manufacturing, assistant to the president and vice president [s7].
  • Li Weihua (female, born 1977), chief financial officer since 2025-11-01, also a member of the executive committee, secretary of the board's audit committee, and a director of JMC Ford Automotive Technology (Shanghai) and Hanon Automotive Parts (Nanchang). She holds a bachelor's degree in international economic law from Shanghai University of Finance and Economics and an MBA from York University's Schulich School of Business; she previously served as a Ford China financial analyst, financial analyst and manager at Ford Automotive Engineering Research (Nanjing), various Ford Asia-Pacific finance posts, CFO of Ford Lio Ho Motor, CFO of JMC, and CFO of Changan Ford Automobile [s16].

Shareholding and governance

As of end-2025 the controlling shareholders were Nanchang Jiangling Investment Co., Ltd. (41.03%, a state-owned legal person) and Ford Motor Company (32.00%); the annual report identifies Jiangling Motors Group Co., Ltd. and Chongqing Changan Automobile Co., Ltd. as the actual controllers [s1]. The 2026 third-quarter report's top-10 shareholders show the same two largest holders at about 41.03% and 32.00% [s3]. Ford appoints directors to the board, including vice chairman Wu Shengbo and another Ford-appointed director (Ryan Anderson); in 2025 the board resolved on related-party transactions with Ford concerning distribution and the capital increase of JMC Ford Automotive Technology (Shanghai) [s17].
leadership.zh:
创始人

江铃汽车并无单一创始人。其前身为 1947 年 4 月成立的国有南昌汽车保养厂，1967 年 10 月更名为江西汽车制造厂、1968 年开始整车制造；财务报告记载公司于 1992 年 6 月 16 日在江西汽车制造厂基础上改组设立为中外合资股份制企业，集团官网另记载股份公司 1993 年 11 月 22 日创立 [s1][s4]。

核心管理层

  • 邱天高（1966 年生），董事长，2016-04-07 起任。同时任江铃汽车集团有限公司董事长（2014 年 4 月起）、南昌市江铃投资有限公司董事长、江西五十铃汽车有限公司董事长、江西江铃集团新能源汽车有限公司董事长。曾任南昌齿轮有限公司总经理、董事长，江西江铃齿轮股份有限公司董事长，江铃控股有限公司副总裁，江铃汽车集团公司董事、总经理、董事长 [s1][s4]。
  • 熊春英（1964 年生），董事（2021-06-25 起任）、总裁（2021-05-01 起任）。高级工程师，曾任质管部部长、总裁助理、副总裁、执行副总裁、董事 [s1]。
  • 吴胜波（1966 年生，美国籍），副董事长（2022-11-24 起任）。现任福特汽车公司集团副总裁、中国及国际市场集团总裁兼首席执行官，福特汽车（中国）有限公司董事长、总裁兼首席执行官 [s1]。
  • 丁文敏（1972 年生），第一执行副总裁（2026-09-29 起任；此前 2022-06-01 起任执行副总裁）。现任江铃汽车集团有限公司党委常委、江铃汽车股份有限公司党委书记。曾任产品开发技术中心副主任、产品策划及项目管理部部长、总裁助理、副总裁，江铃集团董事 [s7]。
  • 衷俊华（1976 年生），董事（2024-04-11 起任）。2026 年 9 月因组织安排辞去执行副总裁职务（该职自 2024-03-26 起任）、调任江铃汽车集团有限公司党委副书记、总经理、董事，辞任后仍担任上市公司董事 [s1][s6]。
  • 曾发发（1978 年生），执行副总裁（2026-09-29 起任）。曾任质管部副部长、新车型投产管理部部长、质管部部长、制造部部长、总裁助理、副总裁 [s7]。
  • 李伟华（女，1977 年生），财务总监，2025-11-01 起任，同时任执行委员会委员、董事会审计委员会秘书、江铃福特汽车科技（上海）董事、翰昂汽车零部件（南昌）董事。上海财经大学国际经济法专业学士、加拿大约克大学舒立克商学院工商管理硕士；曾任福特中国财务分析师，福特汽车工程研究（南京）财务分析师、财务经理，福特亚太生产制造财务经理、产品开发财务经理、生产制造主计长、产品开发主计长，福特六和财务总监，江铃汽车财务总监，长安福特汽车财务总监（财务副总裁）[s16]。

股权与治理

截至 2025 年末，控股股东为南昌市江铃投资有限公司（持股 41.03%，国有法人）与福特汽车公司（持股 32.00%）；年报认定的实际控制人为江铃汽车集团有限公司、重庆长安汽车股份有限公司 [s1]。2026 年三季报披露的前十大股东中，前两大股东持股比例仍约 41.03% 与 32.00% [s3]。福特在董事会派驻董事，包括副董事长吴胜波及另一名福特委派董事 Ryan Anderson；2025 年董事会就与福特的分销委托及江铃福特汽车科技（上海）增资等关联交易作出决议 [s17]。

competition.en:
Main competitors

In light commercial vehicles JMC competes mainly with Beiqi Foton, JAC Motors, Dongfeng and Great Wall Motor's pickup line; in Ford-brand SUVs it competes with Changan Ford and domestic brands. In 2025 JMC's products led the light-bus segment and were No.2 in pickups but only No.7 in light trucks [s8].

Strengths (our assessment)

  • A leading position in light buses and a strong position in pickups, backed by the Ford Transit franchise and the JMC commercial-vehicle network [s8].
  • Growing exports: 160,000 vehicles in 2025, up 38.4% year on year, and a group-level network of 102 overseas dealer channels and 13 KD plants [s8][s15].
  • A long record of cash dividends since listing [s12].

Weaknesses (our assessment)

  • Revenue growth lagged volume growth in 2025 (revenue +2.07% versus volume +10.56%), and the overall gross margin fell to 13.58% [s1][s9].
  • Small NEV scale: NEV sales of 35,806 units in 2025 are a small fraction of total volume [s8].
  • The passenger-vehicle push via JMC Ford Automotive Technology (Shanghai) accumulated losses of about RMB2.37 billion over 2022-2025, and the joint venture is scheduled for liquidation and deregistration after debt settlement [s1][s17].

Our assessment: JMC is a solid but narrow player, strong in light buses and pickups but weak in passenger vehicles and new energy. NEV sales of 35,806 vehicles in 2025, about 9.5% of total volume, indicate that its new-energy business remains limited in scale. The disclosed figures show the commercial-vehicle business carrying the group, while the Ford passenger-vehicle joint venture incurred losses of about RMB2.37 billion over 2022-2025 and has stopped operating [s1]. Profit also depends partly on government grants: in 2025 government grants recognised in the income statement were RMB464.32 million, or roughly 40% of profit attributable to the parent [s1].
competition.zh:
主要对手

轻型商用车领域，江铃主要与北汽福田、江淮汽车、东风及长城皮卡竞争；福特品牌 SUV 领域与长安福特及自主品牌竞争。2025 年江铃产品轻客市占第一、皮卡第二，但轻卡仅列第七 [s8]。

优势（我们的判断）

  • 轻客龙头、皮卡靠前，依托福特全顺品牌与江铃商用车网络 [s8]。
  • 出口持续增长：2025 年出口 16 万辆，同比增长 38.4%；集团层面拥有 102 家海外经销渠道与 13 个 KD 工厂 [s8][s15]。
  • 上市以来长期保持现金分红 [s12]。

短板（我们的判断）

  • 2025 年营收增速（+2.07%）低于销量增速（+10.56%），综合毛利率降至 13.58% [s1][s9]。
  • 新能源规模偏小：2025 年新能源销量 3.58 万台，占总销量比重有限 [s8]。
  • 通过江铃福特汽车科技（上海）推进的乘用车业务 2022—2025 年累计亏损约 23.73 亿元，该合资公司已停止运营、拟在债务清偿后清算注销 [s1][s17]。

我们的判断：江铃是一家业务扎实但较窄的企业，在轻客、皮卡领域较强，乘用车与新能源较弱。2025 年新能源整车销量 35,806 辆、约占总销量的 9.5%，显示其新能源业务规模仍有限。披露数据显示商用车业务支撑整体，而福特乘用车合资公司 2022—2025 年累计亏损约 23.73 亿元、已停止运营 [s1]。盈利对政府补助存在一定依赖：2025 年计入当期损益的政府补助 4.64 亿元，约占归母净利润的四成 [s1]。

outlook.en:
Company targets and plans

JMC set a 2026 operating target of 430,000 vehicles sold and RMB42.0 billion in revenue, and said it would anchor its strategy on three directions: intelligent connectivity, new energy and globalisation [s8]. At the group level, JMCG has outlined a '1236' strategy for 2030: one million vehicles, RMB200 billion in revenue, 30% of sales overseas and 60% NEV share, using a dual-brand, dual-channel export approach [s4].

Our analysis

Our assessment: the disclosed figures point to exports and, to a lesser degree, NEV commercial vehicles as the main growth drivers, while the domestic light-truck market remains competitive and price-sensitive. Whether JMC can lift profitability depends on several conditions: whether NEV commercial-vehicle volumes scale without further eroding gross margin (the overall gross margin fell to 13.58% in FY2025), whether revenue and expenses improve following the passenger-vehicle distribution adjustment, and whether export growth continues in the face of tariffs and geopolitical measures [s9][s17]. None of these conditions is guaranteed.

Our assessment: the year-on-year profit improvement in the first nine months of 2026 includes a comparative-base effect from the prior-year reversal of deferred tax assets. Sustained improvement needs to be assessed against subsequent revenue, gross margins and expenses; if operating performance does not improve, the planned liquidation alone is insufficient evidence of a recovery in profitability [s3][s17].
outlook.zh:
公司目标与规划

江铃汽车制定 2026 年经营目标为销量 43 万辆、营业收入 420 亿元，并表示将锚定智能化、新能源化、全球化三大核心方向 [s8]。集团层面提出面向 2030 年的“1236”战略：整车销量 100 万辆、营业收入 2000 亿元、海外销量占比 30%、新能源销量占比 60%，并采用“双品牌+双渠道”出口策略 [s4]。

我们的分析

我们的判断：披露数据显示出口以及（程度较轻的）新能源商用车是主要增长来源，而国内轻卡市场竞争激烈、价格敏感。江铃盈利能否改善取决于多个条件——新能源商用车能否在不进一步侵蚀毛利率（2025 财年综合毛利率降至 13.58%）的前提下放量，乘用车分销调整后收入与费用表现能否改善，以及出口能否在关税与地缘措施下持续增长 [s9][s17]。这些条件并非必然成立。

我们的判断：2026 年前三季度利润同比改善包含上年同期递延所得税资产转回形成的基数影响。持续盈利改善仍需后续收入、毛利率及费用数据验证；若经营表现未改善，拟清算安排本身不足以支持盈利修复的结论 [s3][s17]。

risks.en:
• Operating risk: revenue grew more slowly than volume in 2025 (revenue +2.07% versus volume +10.56%), and the overall gross margin fell to 13.58% [s1][s9].
  • Financial risk: JMC Ford Automotive Technology (Shanghai) recorded a net loss of RMB751 million in 2025; consolidated accounts receivable at end-2025 were RMB6.141 billion, up 46.89% year on year [s1]. Announcement 2025-042 provides for liquidation and deregistration after debt settlement and states that the capital increase and debt-settlement arrangements have no effect on JMC's total profit (before income tax) [s17]. The 2026 third-quarter report attributes the year-on-year increases in profit attributable to the parent and profit excluding non-recurring items for the first nine months mainly to the effect of deferred tax assets reversed following the subsidiary's business adjustment in the third quarter of 2025 [s3].
  • Customer concentration risk: in 2025 the top five customers accounted for RMB16.54 billion, or 42.22% of sales [s1].
  • Government grants: government grants of RMB464.32 million recognised in the income statement in 2025 accounted for about 40% of profit attributable to the parent [s1][s12].
  • Policy and regulation risk: the commercial-vehicle business faces tightening emissions and safety regulations, which the annual report lists among its core future risks [s8].
  • Overseas risk: exports face uncertainty from tariffs and geopolitical measures in key markets [s8].
  • Technology-route risk: JMC's NEV sales were 35,806 units in 2025, about 9.5% of total vehicle sales [s8].
risks.zh:
• 经营风险：2025 年营收增速（+2.07%）低于销量增速（+10.56%），综合毛利率降至 13.58% [s1][s9]。
  • 财务风险：江铃福特汽车科技（上海）2025 年净亏损 7.51 亿元；江铃汽车合并口径年末应收账款为 61.41 亿元，同比增长 46.89% [s1]。2025-042 号公告约定该合资公司完成债务清偿后清算注销，并明确增资和债务清偿安排对江铃汽车利润总额无影响 [s17]。2026 年三季报解释，前三季度归母净利润及扣非归母净利润同比增长，主要受该子公司在 2025 年第三季度业务调整带来的递延所得税资产转回影响 [s3]。
  • 客户集中度风险：2025 年前五名客户销售额 165.40 亿元，占年度销售总额 42.22% [s1]。
  • 政府补助：2025 年计入当期损益的政府补助 4.64 亿元，约占归母净利润的四成 [s1][s12]。
  • 政策与法规风险：商用车业务面临排放与安全法规趋严，公司年报将其列为核心未来风险之一 [s8]。
  • 海外风险：出口面临重点市场关税与地缘措施的不确定性 [s8]。
  • 技术路线风险：2025 年公司新能源销量为 35,806 台，约占整车销量的 9.5% [s8]。
